text: A one. The dice have chosen violence. Against you.
Natural one. Somewhere, a statistician is weeping with joy.
That roll has been logged, laminated, and mailed to your mother.
One. You failed at the easiest part: luck.

Critical failure. Our insurance department has been notified.
One! Replay that in slow motion. For science.
Twenty! The audience is on its feet. Those who have feet.
Natural twenty. Enjoy it. It will never happen again.
A perfect roll. Suspicious. Our auditors will be in touch.

Critical success. Finally, a reason to keep the cameras on.
Twenty. The dice gods are pleased. They will want something later.

Tragic. Ratings just went up eleven percent.
Contestant deceased. Their inventory is now everyone's problem.
A moment of silence. That's enough. Back to the show.
Death recorded. Cause: optimism.
Gone, but not forgotten. Until the commercial break.
Flatlined. Somebody check their pockets before the cleanup crew does.
Level up! You are now slightly harder to kill. Slightly.
Congratulations. New level, same bad decisions.
You have grown stronger. The dungeon has noticed. It is taking notes.
Level gained. Please collect your complimentary false confidence.
Ding. That's the sound of a bigger target.
Promotion granted. Paperwork to follow. So much paperwork.
Boss incoming! Please keep your limbs inside the party.

Big one. Our betting desk says eleven to one. Against.
Behold your boss. Try to die photogenically.
Boss fight! Sponsors, start your wallets.
Ladies, gentlemen, and things in jars: the main event.
That didn't work. Have you tried being better?
Bold strategy. Let's see if it pays off. It didn't.
Nope. The dungeon says nope.
You failed, but with such confidence.
Swing and a miss. The crowd goes mild.
That attempt has been filed under comedy.
Success! Mark the date. We're making it a holiday.
It worked. Nobody is more surprised than our analysts.
Well done. Don't get used to it.
Clean. Efficient. Deeply unentertaining. Do it again, but louder.
A win! The audience is mildly impressed.
Look at you, accomplishing things.
Still deciding? The monsters are getting bored. So am I.
This is a live broadcast. Live. Do something.
We're losing viewers. Somebody poke something.
Dead air is more dangerous than this dungeon.
Any time now. The dungeon has a schedule.
While you think, here is a word from nobody. Hurry up.
Achievement unlocked! It's worthless, but it's shiny.
New achievement. Your mother will be... informed.
Ding! Another trophy for the shelf you don't own.
Achievement awarded. The committee was not unanimous.
Congratulations. That's going on your permanent record.
Unlocked! Frame it. Hang it. Die near it.
Loot! Open it before something else does.
A box. Could be treasure. Could be teeth.
Prize time! Try to look grateful for the cameras.
Loot acquired. Resale value: a mystery. Mostly to you.
Shiny thing incoming. Grab it, you magpie.
The box rattles. That's either coins or regret.
A sponsor is interested in you. Nobody knows why.
Sponsor alert! Smile. Somebody out there is paying for this.
This moment is brought to you by people with more money than sense.
A gift from a sponsor. Read the fine print. There's a lot.
Your fans pooled their money. Don't waste it. You will.
Sponsor box delivered. They expect a return on investment.
Welcome back to the only show where losing is the content!
Good evening, viewers! Tonight's contestants are already sweating.
Lights, cameras, mortal peril. We are live!
Welcome, heroes. Please sign the waiver. Too late, it's binding.
Hello, galaxy! Let's watch some heroes make choices.
Welcome to the show. Exits are clearly marked. Also locked.
That's our show. Same dungeon next week, fewer survivors.
Goodnight, viewers. Contestants, try not to die off-camera.
Cut! Somebody hose down the set.
We're out of time. Your contracts, however, are not.
Thanks for watching. Remember: someone always loses.
And we're off the air. You can scream now.
Crawler down. Please remain calm. Or don't, it's good television.
And they hit the floor. The floor approves.
Down they go. Somebody fetch a healer.
Monster deleted. Next.
Splat. Lovely.
That one won't be back. Probably.
Critical hit. Ouch, said the audience.
Natural twenty. The monster is thrilled.
A perfect strike. For the wrong team.

Missed by a mile. Two, maybe.

Victory! The crowd goes wild.
Fight won. Loot pending.
All hostiles down. Nicely done.

Look at them go.

Well, nobody saw that coming.
An unprecedented ending.
That's a new one for the archives.

Money: the strongest spell.
Time's up.
